pose: An expansive landscape composition showcasing an extraordinarily rich ecosystem representing distinct Jurassic pterosaur clades arrayed across a tropical island lagoon. In the immediate foreground, a tiny, fuzzy, wide-mouthed anurognathid (Anurognathus) clings vertically to the textured trunk of a Pandanus-like shrub, its large nocturnal eyes wide as it snaps at a Jurassic fly. On the opposite side of the foreground, a slender pterodactylid (Pterodactylus) stands on all fours along the fine white sand, its long, needle-toothed beak dipping down toward a shallow tide pool. Along the sun-drenched limestone banks of the midground, a group of rhamphorhynchids (Rhamphorhynchus) are gathered, showcasing their iconic long, diamond-tipped tails extending behind them as they rest. Anchoring the deep background above the crystal-clear turquoise water, several more rhamphorhynchids are captured mid-flight, diving dynamically toward the surface to catch fish, all set against a high-key, sun-drenched tropical sky.
